items.name: OffsetBuffer
items.summary: A non-empty buffer of monotonically increasing, positive integers.

methods.name: claim
methods.summary: Claim memory used by this buffer in the provided memory pool.

methods.name: from_lengths
methods.signature: fn from_lengths<I>(lengths: I) -> Self where I: IntoIterator<Item = usize>
methods.summary: Create a new [`OffsetBuffer`] from the iterator of slice lengths

methods.name: from_repeated_length
methods.signature: fn from_repeated_length(length: usize, n: usize) -> Self
methods.summary: Create a new [`OffsetBuffer`] where each slice has the same length `length`, repeated `n` times.

methods.name: has_non_empty_nulls
methods.summary: Check if any null positions in the `null_buffer` correspond to non-empty ranges in this [`OffsetBuffer`].

methods.name: lengths
methods.summary: Get an Iterator over the lengths of this [`OffsetBuffer`]

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new [`OffsetBuffer`] from the provided [`ScalarBuffer`]

methods.name: new_empty
methods.summary: Create a new [`OffsetBuffer`] containing a single 0 value

methods.name: new_unchecked
methods.summary: Create a new [`OffsetBuffer`] from the provided [`ScalarBuffer`]

methods.name: ptr_eq
methods.summary: Returns true if this [`OffsetBuffer`] is equal to `other`, using pointer comparisons to determine buffer equality. This is cheaper than `PartialEq::eq` but may return false when the arrays are logically equal

methods.name: slice
methods.signature: fn slice(&self, offset: usize, len: usize) -> Self
methods.summary: Returns a zero-copy slice of this buffer with length `len` and starting at `offset`

methods.name: subtract
methods.signature: fn subtract(self, rhs: O) -> Self where O: std::ops::Sub<Output = O> + std::cmp::PartialOrd + num_traits::CheckedSub
methods.summary: Subtract `rhs` from all offsets This will try to reuse the existing allocation as much as possible
